Phase 1: Event-Traffic Correlation · Phase 2: Pearl-PNS Causal Attribution · Q1/Q2/Q3 Verdicts
Address (a, e, t, k) for audit
All four detectors run in parallel. Traffic detector: 0/7 hijack victims (key negative discriminator).
Confidence threshold τ=0.34 balances precision vs recall on the 29-event ground-truth.
CSS alone: 3/29 events (10.3%). Bayesian synthesis (all 5 channels): 29/29 events.
HCAF never hallucinates alone. LLM is a narrative renderer, not a verdict source.
Confidence < 0.85 to flag for human review.
BGP Tracer: Cloudflare Radar + RIPE RIS + RIPE Atlas + Public Reports · Two-phase attribution pipeline · Interpretable, auditable, reproducible
